ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-contrast dominance; approximately 96% of the surface area consists of low-intensity dark-grey to black pixels, with roughly 4% comprised of high-intensity white clusters and speckles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region covering both lobes; distinct high-contrast white clusters (geometric blobs) located at the distal tips; scattered high-frequency white stippling localized on the left lobe and lower-central notch area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad, shallow U-shaped central depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 145 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge on the left lobe characterized by high-amplitude vertical indentations and jagged serrations; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-amplitude, higher-frequency micro-scalloping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on the distal portions of both lobes, terminating in narrow, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular white pixel clusters localized on the superior-most distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, high-contrast hook-shaped white marking (approx. 50 pixels in length) located in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, non-uniform V-shaped notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from natural serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse, irregular white stippling scattered across the dark central field of the ventral surface.
